objective: Implement GEE V1 R4 Evidence Graph and Evidence Reuse only: deterministic content-addressed evidence identity, dependency-aware selective invalidation, and fail-closed reuse driven by R3 deltas.

prerequisites.statement: GEE V1 R3 delivered: its sealed contract is intact and every declared artifact exists

invariants: Project-agnostic Evidence Graph and CAS core; Wheel interpretation remains in the adapter
Use R2 context and R3 delta interfaces; do not reconstruct or duplicate their logic
Deterministic ordering, content identity and graph output
Reuse is granted only when content, dependencies, parent evidence, provenance and authority inputs remain valid
Missing, removed, tampered or unverifiable evidence fails closed
Unrelated evidence remains reusable when another dependency changes
No mutation of R1, R2 or R3 artifacts, contracts, seals or witnesses
No new ledger, key, witness, release system, remote storage, routing or recovery engine
No network access, staging, commit or push
requiredNegativeTests: tampered CAS content/hash, forged previous identity, missing dependency and missing required evidence fail closed
requiredHostileOrCounterTests: controlled source mutation selectively invalidates direct and downstream evidence while preserving unrelated evidence
evidenceRequirements: unchanged replay and controlled mutation metrics
closureConditions: R4-01 through R4-17 targeted tests PASS
synthetic non-Wheel and Wheel adapter PASS
R2 and R3 interfaces remain non-authoritative and unchanged
invalidationDeclarations: This contract authorizes GEE V1 R4 Evidence Graph / Evidence Reuse only; R5 and later remain unauthorized.
Any mutation of this sealed contract after activation invalidates R4 readiness
Any write outside authorizedPaths invalidates R4 closure
